jobs.title: Product Analyst — Virtual Events and Shareholder Meetings
jobs.location: Edgewood, Long Island, NY or New York, NY — hybrid (2–3 remote days/week)
jobs.salary: $90,000–$115,000 base + bonus eligibility; lower end below $100K target
jobs.why: Early-career-friendly product analyst position explicitly welcomes foundational business analysis experience. Audrey's Orion Salesforce requirements, process mapping, UAT, stakeholder coordination, Tableau/Excel reporting and Horizon Blue ABA workflow improvements align with translating client needs into product requirements, operational process improvement, documentation and cross-functional product delivery. Her UX bootcamp user research also supports customer insight work. No formal product manager experience is required.
jobs.gap: No demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap, go-to-market launch or product pricing analysis, and no domain experience with virtual shareholder meetings/issuer governance. $90K salary floor is below target.
